author: SickProdigy
description: Create static memes locally from original bundled templates or Discord avatars.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not persistently store user data, submitted caption text, avatars, or generated images.
install_msg: This cog bundles original template images and performs local image processing, which may briefly use additional CPU and memory. Use `[p]meme list` to browse templates or `[p]help meme` for generation commands.
name: Meme
